RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Fan the Hammer
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Once per 1.5 seconds, a direct hit launches three missiles, each dealing 5.2 base secondary damage per stack. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Spell Split
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: A Crystal Bolt hit splits toward up to two other enemies within 6 cells. Each shard deals secondary damage based on 26% of the actual hit per stack. Shards cannot split again. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Echo Cast
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: The first effective ability hit on each enemy per cast echoes after 0.75 seconds, dealing secondary damage based on 29.25% of that actual hit per stack. Echoes do not repeat movement, healing, rewards or cast triggers. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Twin Fire
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack grants 6.825% critical value. The first effective ability hit on each enemy per cast fires two missiles, each dealing 6.5 base secondary damage per stack. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Wild Fire
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: While drafted and able to act, automatically strike a visible enemy within 14 cells every 4 seconds, then jump to up to two different enemies within 5 cells of each other. Each hit deals 14.3 base secondary damage per stack. No target means no cooldown spent. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Accelerating Sorcery
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Successful combat casts build sorcery, up to 20 stacks; it expires after 15 seconds without casting. Each sorcery stack grants 5.2% ability haste per card stack. Automatic missiles and echoes are not casts. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Archmage
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Successful combat casts refund 0.65 second per card stack from other recorded personal ability cooldowns. The cast itself receives no refund; an ability cannot recast in the same tick. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Ultimate Awakening
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Casting a personal path ability refreshes basic abilities and grants them 65% ability haste per stack for 8 seconds. Awakening has a separate 15-second interval. Colony abilities do not trigger it. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Multishot
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Crystal Bolt combat hits build shared practice. At 20/40 practice, fire at one/two extra enemies within 7 cells of the target; extra bolts deal 65% of normal base damage. Practice grows at most once per second, benefits from growth bonuses and persists. Teaches Crystal Bolt.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Pursuit of Power
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Crystal Bolt combat hits build shared practice. At 40/80 practice, each card stack grants 48.75%/97.5% bolt damage. Gain at most once per second, affected by growth bonuses and retained in saves. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Pursuit of Haste
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Crystal Bolt combat hits build shared practice. At 40/80 practice, each card stack grants 32.5%/65% bolt haste. Gain at most once per second, affected by growth bonuses. Cooldown remains at least 1 second. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Triggered Inferno
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Alternate direct hits with successful combat casts. A six-step combo blasts enemies within 7 cells for 45.5 base secondary damage and 3.25 base burn damage per pulse per card stack. Repeated step types add nothing. The combo expires after 8 seconds, with a 10-second blast interval. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.
